description: This Scala source file defines a trait 'GraphValidations' containing various validation methods for a DataflowGraph in Spark SQL pipelines, including checks for multi-query table correctness, flow streaming consistency, topological sorting, resettable tables, schema validation, flow resolution, cycle detection, and persisted view source validation.

classes.name: GraphValidations
classes.description: A trait providing validation methods for DataflowGraph objects in Spark SQL pipelines.

methods.name: validateMultiQueryTables
methods.description: Validates correctness of multi-query tables, ensuring non-streaming tables do not support multiple flows.

methods.name: validateFlowStreamingness
methods.description: Checks that each flow's streaming or batch nature matches the dataset type and flow properties.

methods.name: validateGraphIsTopologicallySorted
methods.description: Ensures the graph's flows are topologically sorted, detecting cycles or ordering issues.

methods.name: validateTablesAreResettable
methods.description: Checks that all tables are resettable, focusing on upstream dependencies with streaming downstreams.

methods.name: validateUserSpecifiedSchemas
methods.description: Verifies that user-specified schemas match inferred schemas from flows.

methods.name: validateSuccessfulFlowAnalysis
methods.description: Ensures all flows are resolved and detects cyclic dependencies or unresolved flows.

methods.name: detectCycle
methods.description: Detects cycles in a directed graph using DFS traversal.

methods.name: validatePersistedViewSources
methods.description: Checks that persisted views do not read from invalid sources like temporary views.
